note: Hand-maintained exceptions to the generated Sky vault list. Each entry cites a public document. 'exclude' removes a deployment the chain cannot tell apart from the real one (superseded or test deployments); 'pending' marks a vault that a scheduled spell will onboard. The sync reports a 'pending' entry as stale once the vault holds a rate limit on-chain, so the entry can be removed.
